title: Readiness test seam silently falls back to the raw path when a home cannot be canonicalized, so a misregistered home reintroduces the real-launch race
outcome: test_engram_readiness_seam_key (src/engram_readiness_test_seam.rs) fails at once when a home passed to registration cannot be canonicalized, instead of silently using the raw path, so a test that registers a home before it exists, or spells it differently, cannot fall back to a real readiness launch under the 20 s budget unnoticed. Optionally, tests cover the registry invariants: a double registration panics, and dropping the guard frees the home.
acceptance: Registering a home that does not exist fails the test immediately with a message naming the home; existing seam users still pass.
A test shows that a double registration panics without poisoning the registry, and that a dropped guard frees the home for re-registration.
